# H-E1 Hypothesis Context (JIT Generated by Phase 2C Step 01)

**Source:** 02b_verification_plan.md
**Generated:** 2026-08-04
**Hypothesis ID:** H-E1

---

## Hypothesis Information

**ID:** H-E1
**Type:** EXISTENCE
**Gate:** MUST_WORK
**Prerequisites:** None

**Statement:**
Under fixed Pythia architecture and fixed token budget on open English corpora (Dolma, FineWeb), if PPL threshold τ ∈ {20,35,50} and dedup aggressiveness d ∈ {J=0.7, J=0.9} are independently varied across model scales {70M, 160M}, then a significant Scale × Curation interaction effect will appear in MMLU 4-shot and HellaSwag 0-shot scores because the optimal data quality configuration depends on model capacity.

**Rationale:**
Foundation existence claim. If no interaction exists, H-M2/H-M3 mechanism tests become moot. Confirmed by P1 (Scale × PPL interaction) and P3 (Scale × Dedup sign change) together. Prior work (DataMan) demonstrates scale-sensitivity of PPL/ICL misalignment, motivating this interaction hypothesis.

---

## Variables

- **Independent:** Model scale (70M, 160M), PPL threshold (20, 35, 50), Dedup aggressiveness (J=0.7, J=0.9), Corpus (Dolma, FineWeb)
- **Dependent:** MMLU 4-shot accuracy (primary), HellaSwag 0-shot accuracy
- **Controlled:** Architecture (Pythia), optimizer (AdamW), token budget, contamination rate (ANCOVA covariate), random seed (3 per condition)

---

## Experimental Setup (from Phase 2A via Phase 2B)

**Dataset:**
- Name: Dolma v1.7 (primary) + FineWeb (replication)
- Type: standard
- Source: AI2 Dolma v1.7 (open); HuggingFace FineWeb (open)
- Path: HuggingFace Hub — allenai/dolma, HuggingFaceFW/fineweb
- Hypothesis Fit: Both are fully open English web corpora with documented filtering pipelines enabling reproducible perplexity filtering and MinHash deduplication at different thresholds

**Model:**
- Name: Pythia 70M + Pythia 160M (trained from scratch)
- Type: Autoregressive transformer, decoder-only
- Source: EleutherAI Pythia architecture; training via GPT-NeoX
- Hypothesis Fit: Fixed architecture across all conditions; well-documented; established in pre-training ablation literature; checkpoints at multiple scales from same architecture family enable scale comparison

---

## Verification Protocol

1. Run NeMo-Curator to generate 6 filtered corpus variants per corpus (3 PPL × 2 dedup) on Dolma v1.7 and FineWeb; record corpus size and contamination rate per condition.
2. Train 24 models (2 scales × 6 filter conditions × 2 corpora) from scratch using GPT-NeoX; 3 seeds each = 72 total training runs; evaluate with lm-evaluation-harness (MMLU 4-shot + HellaSwag 0-shot) at final checkpoint.
3. Run lm-sys/llm-decontaminator on each filtered corpus against MMLU and HellaSwag test sets; record contamination rate CR(condition).
4. Fit 2-way mixed ANOVA with factors Scale × PPL-threshold; include contamination rate as ANCOVA covariate; test interaction term F_{Scale×PPL}; identify τ*(N) per scale via simple effects analysis.
5. Also test Scale × Dedup interaction (P3); verify sign(B(strict)−B(loose)) at each scale.

---

## Success Criteria (PoC: Direction-based)

- **Primary:** Scale × PPL-threshold ANOVA interaction p < 0.05, partial η² ≥ 0.15, τ*(70M) < τ*(160M)
- **Secondary:** Scale × Dedup interaction p < 0.05 with sign change confirmed (P3)

---

## Gate Conditions

- **Gate Type:** MUST_WORK
- **Pass Condition:** Scale × PPL ANOVA p < 0.05, partial η² ≥ 0.15, correct direction
- **Fail Action:** STOP → reassess hypothesis; escalate to Phase 2A-Dialogue

---

## Failure Response

- IF interaction p > 0.05 AND partial η² < 0.15: PIVOT — check if contamination covariate absorbs all variance; re-run with wider τ range {10, 35, 70}
- IF interaction in opposite direction: EXPLORE — report as null finding with methodological contribution; escalate to Phase 2A-Dialogue

---

## Dependencies

None (foundation hypothesis — root of DAG)

---

## Controlled Variables (from Phase 2B Section 1.3)

- Dataset: Dolma v1.7 (primary) + FineWeb (replication)
- Model: Pythia-architecture 70M and 160M (trained from scratch)
- Optimizer: AdamW, lr=1e-3 (70M), lr=6e-4 (160M), cosine decay
- Batch size: 2M tokens
- Total tokens: 50B tokens per run
- Checkpoint interval: Every 5B tokens (10 checkpoints per run)
- Seeds per condition: 3
